value.rationale: The first-two-moment diffusion approximation for random reset amplitudes is an explicit research motivation, and the constructed two physical protocols remain indistinguishable even by exact stationary variance while having opposite finite/infinite fourth-moment behavior. The all-real-order cutoff ordering and inverse-s singular separation explain a structural, not merely arithmetic, failure of high-moment closure. Applicable to diagnosing rare but large stationary fluctuations in marked catastrophe/reset models.
